The connected gateway remains authoritative at runtime. A tool can be hidden or rejected by scopes, tenant policy, rollout flags, or a circuit breaker even when it appears in this release reference.

| Tool | Mode | Required scope | Schema | Stability | Maturity | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bootstrap_hq_workspace` | commit | `settings.read` | 1.0.0 | draft | active | Start an authenticated X1 HQ connection by resolving the user's workspace and optional company, brand, or shop names. Selects and persists a unique match; otherwise returns the shortest candidate list the user must disambiguate. Call this before any non-bootstrap HQ tool. |
| `call_hq_commit_tool` | commit | `settings.read` | 1.0.0 | beta | active | Execute one enabled commit tool returned by find_hq_tools only after its ordinary preview and explicit approval requirements are satisfied. The gateway validates the exact target schema and preserves the target tool's scope, tenant, approval, idempotency, task, readback, and audit rules. |
| `call_hq_preview_tool` | preview | `settings.read` | 1.0.0 | beta | active | Execute one enabled non-mutating preview tool returned by find_hq_tools. The gateway validates arguments against that tool's exact schema and enforces its original delegated scope, tenant boundary, quota, persistence, and audit rules. |
| `call_hq_read_tool` | read | `settings.read` | 1.0.0 | beta | read-only | Execute one enabled read tool returned by find_hq_tools. The gateway validates arguments against that tool's exact schema and enforces its original delegated scope and tenant boundary before execution. |
| `commit_clear_hq_workspace_selection` | commit | `settings.read` | 1.0.0 | draft | active | Clear the persisted MCP workspace selection for this authenticated assistant connection. |
| `commit_select_hq_business_scope` | commit | `settings.read` | 1.0.0 | draft | active | Persist or change the default HQ company/brand/shop scope inside the already selected workspace. |
| `commit_set_hq_workspace` | commit | `settings.read` | 1.0.0 | draft | active | Persist the selected HQ workspace for this authenticated assistant connection. workspaceId is the Clerk organization/workspace id; optional companyId/brandId/shopId set a default business scope inside that workspace. |
